Hi Tara / EdgeWave legal —

Thanks again for the productive call yesterday. Per our follow-up, I attached our proposed redline to the Order Form (EdgeWave_OrderForm_v3_redline.pdf) that contains the confidentiality/publicity section we discussed. Key asks from our side:

- Preserve the limited reference right (one case study + short quote) with written approval prior to publication.
- Logo use: allow a single co-branded placement for press and marketing but require adherence to our logo guidelines (attached).
- Embargo window: we typically request a 5-business-day notice after contract execution; you mentioned you may need a longer window for large accounts.

Can you confirm whether EdgeWave can accept the publicity carveout in section 4.2 (we added proposed language for approval turnaround and approval not to be unreasonably withheld)? Also looping in Kimberly for legal commentary.

Next steps I propose: if you can send back your in-house redlines, Kimberly and I will reconcile and produce a short summary so procurement has a clean addendum to transact. If we can align on the embargo and logo matrix today, I’ll kick this to procurement for signature.

Thanks —

Appreciate the quick turnaround and clear summary. I’m attaching EdgeWave’s annotated Order Form (EdgeWave_OrderForm_v3_EW_comments.pdf). A few things from our side:

Tara — Vanessa —

Thanks for the annotated draft. Quick legal read and proposed compromises inline (see msa_publicity_snippet_redline.docx). High-level comments:

1) Reference list vs. case study: We can accept a public customer list (logo grid) for marketing site use provided EdgeWave follows our logo guidelines and the list excludes any sensitive product details. We ask for an opt-out mechanism per customer.

2) Approval turnaround: Redwood will use commercially reasonable efforts to review and respond to publicity requests within 5 business days. If EdgeWave needs 7 business days on your side for embargo planning, we can accept a mutual 7-business-day coordinated window for announcements that require pre-approval.

3) Logo usage: propose a three-tier matrix — (a) Logo grid on website (no approval), (b) Co-branded joint press release or hero placement (prior written approval), (c) Case study with quotes (prior approval + right to minor edits for accuracy). Details and wording are in the attached docx.

If this structure looks OK to EdgeWave legal, we can produce a one-page summary for Joel to attach to the Order Form and hand to procurement.

-Kim
Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

Kim / Vanessa —

Thanks for the clear options. After internal review we can accept the three-tier approach with the following adjustments:

- Embargo window: EdgeWave requests a firm 10 business days for our press calendar on enterprise announcements. We will accept a mutual 7-business-day window for product-level case studies but request 10 business days for company-level press.
- Logo grid: happy to allow logo grid placement on marketing site without per-customer approval, provided the logos are used per the attached logo usage spec.
- Co-branded hero placements: EdgeWave will require prior written approval; we propose a 3-business-day approval turnaround to avoid stalls.
- Reference quotes: EdgeWave can provide quotes but needs the right to review and provide a final sign-off; Redwood’s right to make minor corrections for accuracy is acceptable.

We’ve prepared a short addendum language block we can insert into the Order Form and a DocuSign envelope is ready: https://docusign.com/embeddedSigning/EA-2029-348.
